BLUESKY_HANDLE.title: Bluesky handle
BLUESKY_HANDLE.description: Your Bluesky handle (e.g. yourname.bsky.social). Used with the app password to create a session.

BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD.title: Bluesky app password
BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD.description: App password from Bluesky Settings → App passwords. Do not use your main account password.
